bullets.text: Personal auto generated strongest new application growth in some time; Direct PIF +13% YOY; Agency new apps +7% YOY; PLE up ~2% in Agency and ~5% in Direct across nearly 11.5M customers.

Combined ratio of 92.7 reflected good margins across all business segments. Commercial Auto profitability remained strong. Operational and investment achievements were acceptable, with key measures starting to reflect progress.

Agency auto new apps +7% YOY, marking first step toward positive PIF; Direct channel expanded PIF 13% YOY with stronger new application gains, representing approximately 42% of personal auto customers.

Bodily injury and PIP frequency rose year-to-date but remained comparable to 2007. Collision frequency continued lower. Accurately estimating future PIP severity trends remains a challenge, even with some signs of moderation.

Second-quarter claims staffing adjustments and process changes yielded a one-point run-rate decline in LAE on overall expense, while preserving and enhancing settlement quality gains achieved over the last several years.

Key quarterly measures included a rebound in investment returns and a meaningful increase in capital position. Overall, the third quarter provided a refreshing contrast to the headlines of a year ago.
Progressive.com named best Brand Building Web site in financial services by Forrester and #1 in insurance by Keynote for sixth straight period; online quote volume leads competitors alongside GEICO.

Agency sales momentum reflected competitive positioning and the speed rate changes appear in agent comparative quoting. Independent review confirmed Progressive and GEICO remain well ahead of other carriers in online quoting.

Customer acquisition aided by 'Name Your Price' offering and homeowners affiliation; special lines PIF expanded in low single digits, supported by attractive Net Promoter Scores and related policy renewals.

Special lines sales remained dampened by the economy, but applications improved late in the quarter. Commercial Auto saw a modest reduction in new application decreases, and profitability remained strong.
